basic_details.job_title: AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Nursing Staff post is open on a contractual basis under a research project in the Department of Neuroimaging and Interventional Neuroradiology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi. Candidates must email their updated CV and copies of qualification and experience certificates to [email protected]; the last date for receipt of applications is 4 December 2026, and the interview date is 7 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff
content_sections.text: The post is in the Department of Neuroimaging and Interventional Neuroradiology at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi, a medical institute in New Delhi. The Nursing Staff will work under the research project "(Clinical Trial) Endovascular Therapy for Late Window Ischemic Stroke Patients Selected by Automatic Plain Computed Tomography", AIIMS Research Section Temporary Code CT-1128. The Principal Investigator of the project is Dr. Shailesh B. Gaikwad, HOD, Department of Neuroimaging and Interventional Neuroradiology. The notice describes the project as a privately funded project, with funding agency details "to be verified against the approved institutional record".

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications for the AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff post are sent by email only. The notice does not mention a postal address, an application form or an email subject line. Email address: [email protected] Last date for receipt of applications: 4 December 2026 Documents named in the notice: Updated CV Copies of relevant qualification certificates Copies of relevant experience certificates

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice offers one Nursing Staff post in the Department of Neuroimaging and Interventional Neuroradiology. The eligibility and service conditions printed for the post are: Essential qualification: B.Sc. Nursing / GNM / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing from a recognised institution. Experience: Minimum 2 years' experience. Experience in Operation Theatre (OT) and ward duties is required. Preference: Preference will be given to candidates with experience in Neurology/Neurosciences. Age limit: Below 35 years. The notice does not print a date on which age is counted or any age relaxation. Monthly remuneration: ₹25,000 remuneration + ₹5,000 travel allowance = ₹30,000 per month. Duration of engagement: One year. Proposed joining: 9 December 2026. The engagement is contractual for one year and will be subject to applicable AIIMS rules, project requirements and requisite institutional approvals. For the complete eligibility conditions of the post, candidates can refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff post is by shortlisting and interview. Only shortlisted candidates will be interviewed. The interview date is 7 December 2026, and shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview time, venue/mode and any further instructions.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Nursing Staff post in the Department of Neuroimaging and Interventional Neuroradiology, AIIMS, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff post?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff post?
faq.answer: Candidates need B.Sc. Nursing / GNM / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing from a recognised institution, with minimum 2 years' experience including Operation Theatre (OT) and ward duties.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff post?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is ₹25,000 remuneration + ₹5,000 travel allowance = ₹30,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is the travel allowance paid on top of the ₹30,000?
faq.answer: No. The ₹5,000 travel allowance is part of the ₹30,000 per month; the remuneration itself is ₹25,000.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email your updated CV and copies of relevant qualification and experience certificates to [email protected] so that they are received by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff post?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be interviewed, and the interview date is 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is the AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is contractual for one year under a research project and is subject to applicable AIIMS rules, project requirements and requisite institutional approvals.

faq.question: Q10. Which experience gets preference for the AIIMS New Delhi Nursing Staff post?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates with experience in Neurology/Neurosciences.
